batch_completion: batch process multiple messages concurrently with a single litellm model using thread pool executor
batch_completion_models: send a request to multiple language models concurrently and return the first response received
batch_completion_models_all_responses: send a request to multiple language models concurrently and return all responses from models that respond
batch_completion_models_deployments: send a request to multiple deployments concurrently and return the first successful response
batch_completion_vllm: batch complete messages using the vLLM provider handler with optional parameters
